# Whirlpool data

This function returns some made-up data to test arrow functionality
with.

## Usage

``` r
whirlpool(n = 5L, detail = 100L)
```

## Arguments

- n:

  The number of streams in the whirlpool.

- detail:

  The number of points per stream.

## Value

A `data.frame`

## Examples

whirlpool()
